content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the NFSU Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. content_sections.text: M.Sc. in Forensic Nanotechnology/Nanotechnology/Physics/Chemistry/Materials Science/Forensic Science and relevant disciplines with a minimum aggregate of 60%.

content_sections.heading: NFSU Project Associate Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Project Associate position at NFSU?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Associate position at NFSU is scheduled for 31 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in Forensic Nanotechnology, Nanotechnology, Physics, Chemistry, Materials Science, Forensic Science, or relevant disciplines with a minimum aggregate of 60%.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate position at the National Forensic Sciences University.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this NFSU recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the National Forensic Sciences University in Gandhinagar, Gujarat. The exact venue details will be in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit for this position.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The job type for this Project Associate position is contractual.
